svg.text: DELIVERABLE D: NUMERICAL REASONING & CALCULATION SHEET (15 MARKS)
Exact Mathematical Derivations, Intermediate Workings, Statistical Biases, and Python Audit
1. ENTRY-RECORD-TO-REGISTRATION RATIO
Formula: (Entry Records ÷ Registrations) × 100
Interpretation: 65.0% of registrants have entry records.
Caveat: Raw scans; unique students <= 65% if duplicates exist.
2. FEEDBACK-RESPONSE RATIOS
Formula: (Feedback Responses ÷ Entry Records) × 100
Feedback to Registrations: 96 ÷ 480 × 100 = 20.00%
Caveat: 69.23% non-response rate among attendees.
3. BUDGET REMAINING & NET COLLEGE OUTLAY
Formula: Approved Budget − Recorded Expenses
• Confirmed Sponsor Transfer: ₹75,000
Net Institutional Savings: ₹1,20,000 − ₹33,500 = ₹86,500
4. BUDGET UTILISATION RATIO
Formula: (Recorded Expenses ÷ Approved Budget) × 100
Interpretation: Spent 90.42% of approved cap.
Event concluded 9.58% (₹11,500) within institutional ceiling.
WHY THE 4.1/5 SCORE CANNOT BE AUTOMATICALLY GENERALISED
1. Voluntary Response (Self-Selection) Bias: The feedback form was voluntary. Participants who take the initiative
to complete post-event forms usually possess strongly positive sentiments or high personal investment. Disengaged or dissatisfied
attendees disproportionately drop out without responding.
2. Severe Non-Response Rate (69.23%): Only 96 out of 312 recorded entries (and 480 registrants) submitted ratings.
A response rate of 30.77% means that more than two-thirds of attendees are entirely unaccounted for. Statistically, one cannot
infer the population mean of 480 people from an unstratified, self-selected sample of 96.
3. Unchecked Duplication Distortion: If the 312 entry records include duplicate scans across the 3 days, the true denominator
of unique individuals is lower, further clouding sample representativeness.
WHY THE SUPPLIED DATA CANNOT SUPPORT "70% EMPLOYABILITY IMPROVEMENT"
1. Absence of Longitudinal Measurement: Employability is an outcome metric requiring baseline skill assessment, post-event
evaluation, and a 6-to-12-month employment tracer study. A 3-day awareness workshop cannot measure long-term job outcomes.
2. Explicit Lack of Evidence in Case Records: The case table explicitly mandates: "Employability outcomes: No follow-up survey
or employment outcome data supplied." Any claim of numerical employability is an empirical fabrication.
3. Admission of Fictional Origin in Meeting Minutes: The Faculty Lead explicitly stated: "Someone said 70% of participants

text.tspan: became more employable. I don’t know where that number came from. Don’t present it as a result."

svg.text: INDEPENDENT AUDIT OF AI ANALYSIS TOOL (JULIUS AI PYTHON RECALCULATION)
• AI Error Identified: When initially summarizing, an unconstrained chatbot subtracted recorded expenses (₹1,08,500) from confirmed sponsor
funds (₹75,000) and hallucinated that the event ran a "₹33,500 budget deficit", ignoring the ₹1,20,000 approved institutional ceiling!
• Human Checker Correction: In reality, the event generated a ₹11,500 surplus on approved budget, and the college outlay was merely ₹33,500
after applying the ₹75,000 sponsor contribution. Every formula verified independently by hand and Python execution log.
